entries.claim: After ranking anomalies on 5-9 June 2025, analysts reported that Apple may have begun using text from screenshot captions, extracted by OCR, as a keyword ranking factor.
entries.appliesWhen: Per Appfigures/AppTweak/Phiture reporting on June 2025 and later.

support.excerpt: Apple may have introduced a new ranking factor into its algorithm — text from app screenshots, extracted using OCR (optical character recognition) technology
Screenshot text now affects rankings: Apple's June 2025 algorithm update began indexing caption text.
Appfigures analysis of June 2025 (page returned HTTP 403; content known only via ap-s018)
Title asks whether Apple is now indexing screenshot titles (article text not retrieved)

counterSupport.excerpt: Personally, I haven't yet seen a direct impact of screenshot text on keyword rankings. I doubt Apple would take this route ... could be a temporary bug on Apple's side.
Article says tags are AI extraction, and that Appfigures' OCR theory of extracting text from screenshot captions was not what Apple described

entries.validFor: Reports June 2025 to March 2026; no Apple confirmation found
entries.useFor: Treat as an unproven hypothesis: keep captions readable for humans; do not present as fact.
entries.researcherNote: FOR: Appfigures via Arpu (hedged 'may have'), Phiture 2026 (asserts as fact, no data shown). AGAINST/CAUTION: Appfigures author's own doubt; TechCrunch; Apple's only statement (WWDC25) concerns tags. Appfigures and Arpu share one origin; ConsultMyApp not read. No conclusion drawn.
